safety.text: Akin says she will give law enforcement, firefighters, and EMS the resources and support they need.
safety.quote: Keep families safe by giving law enforcement, firefighters, and EMS the resources and support they need to do their jobs.

trade.text: Sewell criticized tariffs for raising costs and hurting Alabama farmers and families.
trade.quote: Trump's tariffs have cost the average family an extra $1,700.

debt.text: Sewell proposed protecting guaranteed Medicare benefits and maintaining the program's financial sustainability.
debt.quote: Protecting and strengthening Medicare by safeguarding its guaranteed benefits

immigration.text: Sewell voted against a reconciliation bill that funded mass deportation efforts and criticized increased ICE funding without oversight or accountability.
immigration.quote: This bill does nothing to lower costs, nothing to strengthen health care, and nothing to improve the lives of the people I represent. That's why I voted no.

guns.text: Sewell voted to require universal background checks on all firearm sales and transfers.
guns.quote: Requiring universal background checks on the sale of every gun is an essential part of ensuring that guns do not fall into the wrong hands.

abortion.text: Sewell voted for the Women's Health Protection Act and condemned the overturning of Roe v. Wade.
abortion.quote: I believe that a woman's deeply personal health care decisions should be made by her and her doctor, not her politicians.

health.text: Sewell introduced legislation to incentivize states to expand Medicaid coverage under the ACA.
health.quote: In my state, approximately 314,000 more Alabamians would be covered under Medicaid expansion

energy.text: Sewell voted for and celebrated the Inflation Reduction Act's clean energy and climate investments.
energy.quote: making the largest investment to fight climate change in our nation's history

voting.text: Sewell introduced the John R. Lewis Voting Rights Advancement Act to restore and expand voting protections.
voting.quote: The right to vote and safeguard our democracy by restoring and modernizing the full protections of the Voting Rights Act of 1965
